question: For each singer, show the name and how many concerts they performed in. Include singers with no concerts.
reference_sql: SELECT s.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT sic.concert_ID) FROM singer AS s LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID GROUP BY s.Singer_ID, s.Name
candidate_sql:
SELECT s.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT sic.concert_ID) AS concert_count
FROM singer AS s
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
    ON CAST(s.Singer_ID AS VARCHAR) = sic.Singer_ID
GROUP BY s.Singer_ID, s.Name;
